verdicts.reason: Both break the brand lockup: HOHOHO sits top-left and AGENCY bottom-left, with a jumble of clipped decorative shapes between them (cut-off triangles, a sliced black circle, a stray C ring). The tagline is pushed into a cramped spot on the right, so there is no clear hierarchy or grid. A edges ahead because it breaks the tagline cleanly into 'Office / Secret Santa', while B leaves 'Santa' alone on its own line and packs the text tighter against the tree and the C ring.
